 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORD % 12.09.2024 CRL.M.A. 7553/2024 (for exemption)
1. Exemptions allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

The learned counsel for the respondent relies upon the judgment passed by the Apex Court in the case of A. Subhash Babu v. State of Andhara Pradesh : 2011 7 SCC 616 to contend that when the second marriage is solemnized by supressing the fact of the first marriage, the woman from the second marriage is entitled to maintain a complaint under Section 494 read with Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
